```{r}
# Read full ANES panel data
library(tidyverse)

anes_panel_full <- read_csv(
  "ANES_Panel_Full.csv",
  na = c("", " ", "NA"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
# Select variables needed 
anes_selected <- anes_panel_full %>%
  select(

    # Respondent / Case IDs
    V160001_orig,   # Stable 2016 respondent ID
    V160001,        # 2016 case ID

    # Sample / interview completion status
    V160502,        # 2016 pre/post completion
    V200003,        # 2020 sample type
    V200004,        # 2020 pre/post completion
    V240003,        # 2024 sample type
    V240002c,       # 2024 pre/post completion
    
    # PRE Trump Feeling Thermometer
    V161087,        # 2016
    V201152,        # 2020
    V241157,        # 2024

    # POST Trump Feeling Thermometer
    V162079,        # 2016
    V202144,        # 2020
    V242126,        # 2024

    # PRE Party of Registration
    # Don't use POST here since so many NAs in 2024
    V161019,        # 2016
    V201018,        # 2020
    V241025,        # 2024

    # Race / Ethnicity
    V161310x,       # 2016
    V201549x,       # 2020
    V241501x,       # 2024

    # PRE Liberal-Conservative Self-Placement
    # Don't use POST here since we only have 2016 data
    V161126,        # 2016
    V201200,        # 2020
    V241177,        # 2024

    # Respondent Gender / Sex
    V161342,        # 2016
    V201600,        # 2020
    V241550,        # 2024

    # State
    V161010d,       # 2016 FIPS state
    V203000,        # 2020 FIPS state
    V243002,        # 2024 FIPS state

    # PRE / POST Weights
    V160101,        # 2016 PRE weight
    V160102,        # 2016 POST weight

    V200011a,       # 2020 panel PRE weight
    V200011b,       # 2020 panel POST weight

    V240106a,       # 2024 panel PRE weight
    V240106b,       # 2024 panel POST weight

    # PSU / Stratum
    V160201,        # 2016 Stratum – Full sample 
    V160202,        # 2016 Variance PSU – full sample 

    V200011c,       # 2020 panel variance unit
    V200011d,       # 2020 panel variance stratum

    V240106c,       # 2024 panel PSU
    V240106d        # 2024 panel stratum
  )
```


```{r}
# Convert ANES panel from Wide to long format

anes_long <- anes_selected %>%

  # Standardize variable types before reshaping
  mutate(
    across(
      -c(V160001_orig, V160001),
      ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(trimws(as.character(.x))))
    )
  ) %>%

  # Rename variables to common names across years
  rename(

    # Interview completion status
    completion_status_2016 = V160502,
    completion_status_2020 = V200004,
    completion_status_2024 = V240002c,

    # Sample type
    sample_type_2020 = V200003,
    sample_type_2024 = V240003,

    # PRE Trump Feeling Thermometer
    trump_ft_pre_2016 = V161087,
    trump_ft_pre_2020 = V201152,
    trump_ft_pre_2024 = V241157,

    # POST Trump Feeling Thermometer
    trump_ft_post_2016 = V162079,
    trump_ft_post_2020 = V202144,
    trump_ft_post_2024 = V242126,

    # PRE Party of Registration
    party_reg_pre_2016 = V161019,
    party_reg_pre_2020 = V201018,
    party_reg_pre_2024 = V241025,

    # Race / Ethnicity
    race_2016 = V161310x,
    race_2020 = V201549x,
    race_2024 = V241501x,

    # PRE Liberal-Conservative Self-Placement
    ideology_pre_2016 = V161126,
    ideology_pre_2020 = V201200,
    ideology_pre_2024 = V241177,

    # Respondent Gender / Sex
    gender_2016 = V161342,
    gender_2020 = V201600,
    gender_2024 = V241550,

    # State
    state_fips_2016 = V161010d,
    state_fips_2020 = V203000,
    state_fips_2024 = V243002,

    # PRE Weights
    weight_pre_2016 = V160101,
    weight_pre_2020 = V200011a,
    weight_pre_2024 = V240106a,

    # POST Weights
    weight_post_2016 = V160102,
    weight_post_2020 = V200011b,
    weight_post_2024 = V240106b,

    # PSU
    psu_2016 = V160202,
    psu_2020 = V200011c,
    psu_2024 = V240106c,

    # Stratum
    stratum_2016 = V160201,
    stratum_2020 = V200011d,
    stratum_2024 = V240106d
  ) %>%
  
  # Convert wide format into long format
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(V160001_orig, V160001),
    names_to = c(".value", "year"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_(2016|2020|2024)$",
    names_transform = list(year = as.integer),
    values_drop_na = FALSE
  ) %>%

  # Sort by respondent and year
  arrange(V160001, year)
```


```{r}
# Check dimensions
dim(anes_long)

# Check number of observations per year
anes_long %>%
  count(year)

# Check number of unique respondents
n_distinct(anes_long$V160001_orig)

# Check number of rows per respondent
anes_long %>%
  count(V160001_orig) %>%
  count(n)

# Preview dataset
head(anes_long, 15)
```


```{r}
write_csv(
  anes_long,
  "ANES_CleanedPanel_Long.csv"
)
```
